verdict.evidence_class: cross-fit on the external panel, not a new sealed confirmation

reconstruction.role: the stored policy reconstruction whose absolute error is abserr_policy
reconstruction.note: The risk score does not choose a new reconstructor. Neighbour regression remains the donor path already inside that policy. Air-temperature regression is not the primary reconstructor.

risk_score.name: fitted_risk
risk_score.features: generic_plus_support, the 22 decision-time features used by scripts/301

threshold.rule: largest grid point whose independence-group clustered bootstrap upper bound at 1 - 0.05/86 is <= 0.05
threshold.label_rule: for each outer test fold, calibration scores and the threshold are computed without that fold's labels
threshold.fold_unit: connected component of networks that share a station_id
threshold.what_this_is_not: not a distribution-free post-selection guarantee for an unseen archive

action: admit the repaired hottest-30 value if score <= threshold; otherwise abstain

primary_benefit.contrast: retention of fitted_risk minus retention of peak_overlap_rule
not_the_primary_contrast: error-rate drop at a fixed 70% retention
retention gain versus the gap-length rule

evidence_identity.fitted_risk_on_wave2: cross-fit on the external panel after this repair; not the sealed confirmation of a frozen model
evidence_identity.frozen_certificate_wave2_fixed70: historical confirmation of a different object, the frozen certificate screen
evidence_identity.real_calendar_replay: development-period probe until it is rerun with this config
evidence_identity.previous_27pp_sentence: pending — exploratory data, not a conclusion, until replaced by the isolated table
